column1: # Trust windows: the last time each run's solution can be trusted -- one line per run, tab-separated.
# research/merger/closeout.sh cuts the run's movies there (rerender_frames.py --t-max): only frames at or
# before t_max set the colour scale and are stitched; later frames stay on disk, untouched.  Figures and the
# paper quote nothing after t_max either.  Add the row when the window is measured, then re-run the close-out.

column3: the 1+log collapse front reaches the outer face (x = 256) at t = 218 and its reflection runs back to the neck (x-t diagram of the lapse slice cache); the far horizon track is lost at t = 212, L2 H > 0.1 from t = 220, and grid noise grows on the neck sphere until the NaN at t = 392.36 (GPU_PLAN 2026-09-26 05:00)

the mouths inflate past the scan window from t = 43 and the constraint norms grow by orders of magnitude (L2 H 5.8e-4 at t = 40, 2.5e-2 at t = 70, 0.51 at t = 100; L2 M 4.9e-4, 2.0e-2, 0.13); the waves are quoted to the matching retarded time t - R <= 50 (the gallery gate); set 2026-09-26 on the referee fixes

the throat collapses on its own unstable mode from t = 30 (R_min -11.4 % at t = 48, -30.1 % at t = 53); chi at the pit sits on or near its floor from t = 52.2, max |K| climbs from 0.74 at t = 53 to 5.4, and the run NaNs at t = 53.43 (h11, level 4)

the merged core's K runaway starts at t ~ 19.3 (max |K| 0.15 at 19.05, 0.39 at 19.56, 0.88 at 20.58) and the run NaNs at t = 20.61 (K, level 3); constraints flat to the end (L2 H <= 1e-2), and the common MOTS (found from t = 12.5, R 5.624 -> 5.120) is tracked to the last plotfile t = 20.5

the merged structure inflates and L2 H grows x1.3 per unit from t ~ 50, crossing the p = 0.45 fly-by criterion 2.5e-2 at t = 56.3 (2.3e-2 at 56.1, 4.2e-2 at 58.1; L2 M follows): the csm spiral's own cut (t = 57) applied to this arm; the trackers collapse onto the central pit at t = 38.06 and the 3D finder's ±6 window is too small from t ~ 61; NaN in h11 (level 2) at t = 71.78

the merged core's K runaway: max |K| grows ~0.13/unit from t ~ 19 (0.33 at 20, 0.87 at 25.0), turns exponential at t ~ 25.8 (1.9 at 25.78, 4.1 at 26.1), and the leg was stopped by hand at t = 26.26 before the NaN (the scout's death 5 units later at level 5); constraints flat to the stop (L2 Ham 4.4e-4), the common MOTS (from t = 13, R 5.600 -> 4.946) tracked to the last plotfile t = 26; leg 2 (lvl6from25_r02500) continues from Chk02500

single-cell NaN in h11 at the merged core centre, level 6, t = 29.407 (post_timestep check): grid-scale core instability, not the K wall -- Ham 1.9e-4 and max |K| 1.95 falling to the end; plotfiles clean through t = 29; superseded by the lvl7from25 rerun

single-cell NaN in h11 at the merged core centre, level 7, t = 27.53: TWO UNITS EARLIER than the lvl6 leg and with max |K| still climbing (5.1 at 27.34, 7.8 at death) -- finer resolution tracks the core blow-up further and dies sooner, so the core instability is not under-resolution; constraints clean to the end (Ham 2.2e-4); MOTS steady (R ~ 4.92); diagnostic arm, wrote no checkpoints
